Build a local BLAST reference database from a BOLD BCDM TSV

bcdm2blastdb.Rd

Build a local BLAST reference database from a BOLD BCDM TSV

Usage

bcdm2blastdb(bcdm_path, db_dir, db_name = "bold_ref_db")

Arguments

bcdm_path

Character. Path to the BCDM TSV file generated by bold_retrieve().

db_dir

Character. Directory to save the formatted FASTA and BLAST database files.

db_name

Character. Base name for the output BLAST database files. Default is "bold_ref_db".

Value

Invisibly returns the base path to the compiled BLAST database (file.path(db_dir, db_name)).

See also

Other blast: blast()
